design.node: Same current built driver against built git-archive baseline and current implementation. 30 warm-up requests and five batches of 500 requests/process; compiler: three warm-ups, five batches of five compiles/process, including output write/read. Timed setup/import/startup excluded.
design.native: Same current built driver against both roots; prefix-only policy has no GraphQL or origin auth. Loopback HTTP with local origin, concurrency one. 1000 warm-ups plus 1000 samples/process. Four separate processes/workload, 2000 measured requests/side. Origin validates path/token; every response must succeed, every origin receipt and cleanup is checked.
design.firstRequestMs: First invocation after module setup is recorded separately; this is not isolated cold-start evidence.
design.variance: Host scheduling/load varied substantially. Small-policy Node and separate 31/32 native controls are retained and must not be interpreted as demonstrated speedups. No significance claim, isolated CPU claim or managed-CDN latency claim.
